ns2:course.label: The Roman Empire
ns2:course.description: Examination of the political, social, economic, military, institutional, religious and cultural development of the Roman Empire from the reign of Augustus (27 BCE - 14 CE) through the fall of the Western Roman Empire ca. 480 CE. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history or consent of instructor.
